response.final_analysis: Pethidine is metabolized to norpethidine, which is neurotoxic and accumulates in renal failure, leading to an increased risk of seizures. This makes pethidine particularly contraindicated in patients with renal failure, more so than morphine, which also has problematic metabolites but less severe compared to the neurotoxic effects of norpethidine. Fentanyl and atracurium are safer alternatives, with atracurium being the safest due to its metabolism being independent of renal function.
